notes.links2025: Municipal point universe selected from top eight harvested-area producers per crop and state; includes 2025 records of all selected municipalities for the 22 covered crops. These are municipal reference coordinates, not fields or a complete universe of producers.
notes.climateAnnual: Simple mean of unique NASA POWER grid cells in a state, not population-, municipality- or area-weighted. 2003 may have different coverage.
notes.cropAnnual: Yearly aggregate of DGSIAP variety records with Nomunidad=Tonelada, summed at state and crop level, 2003-2025. Other production units excluded. Harvest area in ha and physical volume in t.
